Package pacman.model.entity.dynamic.physics

Class BoundingBoxImpl

java.lang.Object
pacman.model.entity.dynamic.physics.BoundingBoxImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BoundingBox
public class BoundingBoxImpl extends Object implements BoundingBox
Standard implementation of an BoundingBox, with O(1) time collidesWith and containsPoint implementations.
